declarations.description: Displays a file or image attachment with a preview, metadata, upload state and optional actions.
declarations.name: Attachment

slots.description: Custom thumbnail or file icon. Replaces the image supplied through `src`.
slots.name: media

slots.description: Custom file name. Falls back to the `name` attribute.
slots.name: name

slots.description: Custom metadata. Falls back to the `type` and `size` attributes.
slots.name: metadata

slots.description: Custom controls shown at the end. Replaces the built-in retry and remove buttons.
slots.name: actions

members.name: name
members.description: File name shown as the primary label.

members.name: src
members.description: Image preview URL. Omit it to show the generic file preview.

members.name: alt
members.description: Accessible description for the image preview. Defaults to the file name.

members.name: type
members.description: File type or extension shown in the metadata row.

members.name: size
members.description: Human-readable file size, for example `2.4 MB`.

members.name: layout
members.description: Auto uses a tile for image previews and a row for files.

members.name: progress
members.description: Upload completion percentage. Values are clamped between 0 and 100.

members.name: removable
members.description: Show the built-in remove action. During upload it is announced as cancel.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disable built-in actions and dim the attachment.

events.name: attachment-remove
events.description: Fired when the remove or cancel action is pressed.

events.name: attachment-retry
events.description: Fired when retry is pressed for a failed upload.

events.name: media-error
events.description: Fired when the image preview cannot be loaded; the file fallback is shown.
